name: Barzillai
overview: Barzillai is a male figure identified as the Meholathite, known primarily as the father of Adriel. His tribal affiliation and additional personal details are not recorded in Scripture. The biblical record provides limited information about him beyond this unique attribute.
namesAndTitles: The name Barzillai means '[made of] iron,' reflecting strength or resilience. This proper name is not indicated to have been given by God, but it carries a significant Hebrew meaning that may suggest steadfastness or durability.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Barzillai as the father of Adriel, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Beyond this, no other family connections or relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Barzillai's significance in the biblical narrative lies in his identification as the Meholathite and as the father of Adriel, connecting him to the lineage and events involving his son. Although details about his life are sparse, his mention anchors genealogical and tribal associations important to the biblical record. His name's meaning may also reflect qualities valued in the biblical context.
